# Amazon Bedrock Runtime

Deterministic fixtures and embeddings by default, with opt-in local inference through Ollama.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `bedrockruntime` |
| Signing name | `bedrock` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2023-09-30` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior; optional Docker or external Ollama inference |
| Selected operations | 6 of 11 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-bedrock-runtime) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No bidirectional streaming or asynchronous inference. Response streams are buffered before AWS frame encoding; embedding models reject response streaming. No simulated mid-stream model failures.
- Text inputs only; multimodal inputs, prompt management, caching, guardrails during inference, reasoning and tool-result conversations are unsupported. Ollama rejects toolConfig unless a fixture matches.
- Local inference retains whitespace token estimates, zero latency and SHA-256 test vectors. Ollama requires local model resources and network access to its server; CountTokens remains a whitespace estimate.
- ApplyGuardrail performs case-insensitive literal substring matching of custom words only; it is explicitly invoked and does not run automatically during inference.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `ApplyGuardrail` | `POST /guardrail/{guardrailIdentifier}/version/{guardrailVersion}/apply` |
| `Converse` | `POST /model/{modelId}/converse` |
| `ConverseStream` | `POST /model/{modelId}/converse-stream` |
| `CountTokens` | `POST /model/{modelId}/count-tokens` |
| `InvokeModel` | `POST /model/{modelId}/invoke` |
| `InvokeModelWithResponseStream` | `POST /model/{modelId}/invoke-with-response-stream` |
